**Kitchen Sink Problem:** This copy tries to hit every dog health issue imaginable:
- Joint problems
- Digestive issues  
- Bad breath
- Shedding
- Itchy skin
- Separation anxiety
- Aggressive behavior
- Low energy
- Poor coat quality
